code_improvements.title: Add @cache_page to Purchasing and Inventory Dashboards
code_improvements.description: Apply the @cache_page(300) decorator to the purchasing dashboard and inventory dashboard views, which currently execute expensive aggregation queries without any caching.
code_improvements.rationale: The @cache_page(300) pattern is already established in apps/materials/views.py (dashboard_materials) and apps/production/views.py (production_order_list). Purchasing and inventory dashboards perform similar expensive Count() and Sum() aggregations but lack this optimization. The pattern is proven and requires only adding the decorator.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Import cache_page from django.views.decorators.cache at the top of each file, then add @cache_page(300) decorator above @login_required on the dashboard() functions. The 300 seconds (5 minutes) cache time matches the existing pattern in materials and production modules.

code_improvements.title: Add CSV Export Endpoint for Stock List
code_improvements.description: Add a CSV export endpoint for the stock_list view that allows users to download the current filtered stock data as a CSV file, using the same filter parameters (search, warehouse, material_type, stock_status) already implemented in the view.
code_improvements.rationale: The stock_list view already has comprehensive filtering logic and returns structured data with material code, name, warehouse, quantities, etc. Django provides built-in CSV response capabilities. Reports views already aggregate similar data. This extends the existing list view pattern to include export capability.
builds_upon: Django's HttpResponse with CSV content type
existing_patterns: List view filtering pattern with Q objects
Django CSV export pattern using csv.writer
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Create a new stock_export_csv() view that reuses the same queryset and filter logic from stock_list(). Use Django's HttpResponse with content_type='text/csv' and Content-Disposition header. Write rows using csv.writer with columns: Material Code, Material Name, Warehouse, Current Qty, Reserved Qty, Available Qty, Min Stock, Max Stock, Last Movement. Add URL pattern for 'stock/export/csv/'.

code_improvements.title: Add MaterialCategory Search API Endpoint
code_improvements.description: Add a JSON API endpoint for searching MaterialCategory records, similar to the existing material_search_api endpoint, to enable dynamic category selection in forms with typeahead/autocomplete functionality.
code_improvements.rationale: The material_search_api pattern is established in apps/materials/views.py:321-347 and returns JSON with id, code, name fields. MaterialCategory model exists with name and description fields but has no search API. Forms currently use static Select widgets for categories. This enables consistent dynamic search across all entity types.
existing_patterns: Q object search on multiple fields
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add category_search_api() view following material_search_api pattern: require min 2 char query, filter MaterialCategory.objects.filter(Q(name__icontains=query) | Q(description__icontains=query), is_active=True)[:10], return JsonResponse with id, name, color, description. Add URL path('api/categories/', views.category_search_api, name='category_search_api').

code_improvements.title: Add Batch Cancel Operation for Production Orders
code_improvements.description: Add a bulk cancel endpoint for production orders that follows the existing batch operation pattern (production_order_batch_start, production_order_batch_complete), allowing users to cancel multiple DRAFT or PLANNED orders at once.
code_improvements.rationale: The production module already has batch start (line 174-246) and batch complete (line 251-323) operations with the same structure: JSON body parsing, order_ids list, atomic transaction, success/error counting. The ProductionOrder model has CANCELLED status and could support batch cancellation. This completes the batch operations set.
builds_upon: Atomic transaction pattern for batch operations
existing_patterns: JSON body parsing with fallback to POST data
JsonResponse with success, message, count, errors fields
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add cancel() method to ProductionOrder model that validates status in ['DRAFT', 'PLANNED'] and sets status='CANCELLED'. Create production_order_batch_cancel() view by copying production_order_batch_start and replacing start() with cancel(). Add URL path('orders/batch/cancel/', views.production_order_batch_cancel, name='order_batch_cancel').

code_improvements.title: Add Bin History CSV Export
code_improvements.description: Add a CSV export endpoint for the bin_history view that exports the complete movement history of a specific bin, using the same date range and type filters already implemented in the view.
code_improvements.rationale: The bin_history view (apps/production/views.py:531-574) already implements date_from, date_to, and type_filter parameters with pagination. BinHistory model contains structured data (movement_type, material, quantity, supplier_batch, certificate, performed_by, created_at). CSV export follows the same pattern proposed for stock_list export.
existing_patterns: History view filtering by type and date range
QuerySet with select_related for related data
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Create bin_history_export(request, bin_id) view that applies same filters as bin_history(), then writes CSV with columns: Date, Type, Material, Quantity, Qty Before, Qty After, Supplier Batch, Certificate, Performed By, Notes. Use HttpResponse with text/csv content type and Content-Disposition: attachment with bin code in filename. Add URL path('bins/<uuid:bin_id>/history/export/', views.bin_history_export, name='bin_history_export').
